messages:
maria: Quick sync — closing postmortem and assigning remediation owners. We need clear owners, timelines, and a recurring review cadence for rollout patterns observed last week.

jon: +1. Main asks: auto-rollback thresholds, tighter gradual ramps, and sampling for heavy paths.

kevin: Agreed. I'll take ownership of auto-rollback config and telemetry gaps. Will propose concrete rules.

ani: I'll own blast-radius controls (flag scoping + guardrails). Also want a playbook snippet we can use in runbooks.

maria: Great. How about action items? Keep them small and timeboxed.

jon: AI-01 — auto-rollback rules: owner=kevin, due=2025-06-02. Short plan: default p50/p95 latency checks and error-rate fallback.

kevin: AI-02 — telemetry: owner=jon, due=2025-05-30. Add per-flag sampling + end-to-end trace linking in request_id.

ani: AI-03 — flag scoping and default deny limits: owner=ani, due=2025-05-28. Will add namespace-level caps and 'max-affected' parameter.

maria: AI-04 — recurring incident pattern review: owner=maria, cadence=biweekly, first=2025-06-10. Agenda: check regressions, rollout outcomes, and postmortem open items.

jon: Sharing a quick config example for auto-rollback we can iterate on:

```json
{"flag":"search_routing_v2","rollout_percent":15,"check":{"metric":"p50_latency_ms","threshold":300,"window_min":10},"actions":{"rollback":"immediate","notify":"#incidents"}}
```

kevin: Suggest making 'rollback' exponential backoff rather than immediate for noisy metrics. Also add a secondary check on error rate.

maria: Good call. Add an escape hatch to bypass auto-rollback for infra releases.

deploy-bot: Deploy history note: last staged rollout for search_routing_v2 ramped 0->15% at 2025-05-12 14:23Z, observed p95 spike at 14:27Z.

ani: I'll draft a short playbook with example flag yaml + rollback heuristics and post link here by EOD Friday.

kevin: Will prototype the metric evaluator and run a few simulations against real traces.

jon: I'll add instrumentation tasks to the backlog and bump the priority for request_id propagation.

maria: Thanks. Can each owner drop a one-line daily update in this thread until closure? :thumbsup: 

kevin: will do.

ani: yep.

jon: done.

maria: Closing note — let's keep remediation items under 2 weeks unless they require infra changes; escalate if blocked. Thanks all :raised_hands:
